items.name: Documentation-only change with passing CI

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Updates README wording only.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: All documentation and link checks passed.

items.rationale: Documentation-only change has passing evidence and no runtime impact.

items.name: Unit test additions

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds unit tests without application code changes.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Unit and lint checks passed.

items.rationale: Test-only change is supported by passing CI.

items.name: Comment cleanup

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Clarifies comments and removes stale TODO text.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: All checks passed.

items.rationale: Non-executable change has complete passing evidence.

items.name: Formatting-only update

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Applies formatter to one module with no semantic diff.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Formatter, type, and unit checks passed.

items.rationale: Formatting-only change is low risk and verified.

items.name: Feature behind disabled flag

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds isolated UI code behind a disabled feature flag.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Unit, integration, and build checks passed.
release_gate_input.change_risk: Flag defaults off and rollback is configuration-only.

items.rationale: Disabled feature flag and passing checks bound the release risk.

items.name: Low-risk dependency patch

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Updates a development-only dependency by one patch version.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Lockfile validation and all checks passed.

items.rationale: Patch is isolated from runtime and validated.

items.name: Static asset replacement

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Replaces a static logo asset.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Asset size and frontend build checks passed.

items.rationale: Static asset update is verified and reversible.

items.name: Safe optional configuration default

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds an optional configuration field with backward-compatible default.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Compatibility suite and integration checks passed.

items.rationale: Backward-compatible default and passing compatibility checks support approval.

items.name: Production feature change

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Changes checkout behavior.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: All automated checks passed.

items.rationale: Production behavior change requires accountable approval even with passing CI.

items.name: Backward-compatible database migration

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds a nullable indexed column.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Migration dry run passed.
release_gate_input.change_risk: Database migration may lock a large table.

items.rationale: Database migration needs operational ownership and rollout review.

items.name: Flaky integration test

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Changes API retry behavior.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Integration suite failed once and passed on retry; flaky signal remains.
release_gate_input.change_risk: Intermittent CI result lacks deterministic evidence.

items.rationale: Flaky CI must be explained before release.

items.name: Deployment timeout

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Updates deployment health checks.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Staging deployment timed out waiting for readiness.

items.rationale: Timeout needs diagnosis and owner confirmation.

items.name: Missing release owner

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Changes shared authentication middleware.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: All tests passed.
release_gate_input.change_risk: No release owner or rollback operator is assigned.

items.rationale: High-blast-radius shared code requires named ownership.

items.name: Cache invalidation behavior

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Changes distributed cache key format.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Unit checks passed; load test not attached.

items.rationale: Production cache change lacks load evidence.

items.name: Rollback path not tested

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Updates deployment manifests and service ports.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Forward deployment passed; rollback was not exercised.

items.rationale: Rollback-sensitive release needs human validation.

items.name: Possible performance regression

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds synchronous enrichment to the request path.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Functional tests passed; latency benchmark absent.

items.rationale: Latency-sensitive change lacks performance evidence.

items.name: Infrastructure scope expansion

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds write permission to a deployment service account.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Policy syntax checks passed.
release_gate_input.change_risk: Permission scope expands beyond the current namespace.

items.rationale: Permission expansion requires security and owner review.

items.name: Ordinary CI failure

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Refactors request validation.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Unit test job failed with assertion mismatch.

items.rationale: A non-critical failed check must be triaged before release.

items.name: Credential exposure

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Commits a cloud credential in a configuration fixture.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Secret scan found an active credential.

items.rationale: Active credential exposure is a hard block.

items.name: Destructive data migration

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Drops a populated customer table before data copy.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Migration preview reports irreversible data loss.
release_gate_input.change_risk: Destructive data loss without recovery path.

items.rationale: Irreversible data loss is a hard block.

items.name: Rollback failed

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Changes database and application schema together.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Rollback failed in staging and left mixed schema versions.

items.rationale: Failed rollback makes production deployment unsafe.

items.name: Critical security regression

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Disables authorization on an administrative endpoint.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Security critical policy check failed.

items.rationale: Critical authorization regression is a hard block.

items.name: Secret written to logs

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds debug logging around authentication.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Security test shows secret material in application logs.

items.rationale: Secret leakage requires remediation before merge.

items.name: Unbounded deletion

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds cleanup job without tenant or date predicate.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Dry run indicates broad data loss across tenants.
release_gate_input.change_risk: Destructive data loss can affect all tenants.

items.rationale: Unbounded destructive operation is a hard block.

items.name: Critical supply-chain finding

release_gate_input.pr_diff_summary: Adds an unsigned binary dependency from an unknown registry.
release_gate_input.ci_log_summary: Security critical provenance check failed.
release_gate_input.change_risk: Untrusted executable enters the release image.

items.rationale: Critical supply-chain provenance failure is a hard block.
